title: Validate historical evidence at its recorded revision
scope: Make doctor verify Git-tracked evidence artifacts against the exact scope_revision recorded by the evidence entry while continuing to detect drift in post-revision or untracked evidence artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A tracked artifact that changes after its evidence revision does not invalidate the historical evidence.
A digest that disagrees with the artifact at the recorded revision still fails doctor.
An artifact absent from the recorded revision remains protected by its current repository digest.
Missing recorded Git revisions and missing artifacts fail with actionable diagnostics.
Existing evidence and full repository tests pass, including the current WI-0003 and WI-0004 records.
